features.name: Bootstrap the repository
features.description: Create the GitHub repository, push the setup as the one commit made without an issue, and turn on CI.
features.done_when: The repository exists on GitHub; main holds the bootstrap commit; the CI workflow runs ./init.sh and passes on main; the first issues for feat-002 to feat-004 are open.
features.evidence: 2026-11-26: https://github.com/steach-IDE/stroma is public, Apache-2.0 (GitHub detects it). CI on main: baseline success, all green success. Issues open: #3 (feat-002), #4 (feat-003), #5 (feat-004).

features.name: Record the remaining Phase 1 decisions
features.description: The licence is decided (Apache-2.0). Decide the second design system for Phase 1, the LLM policy at extraction, and how CI gets pinned fonts.
features.done_when: Each of the three decisions is in progress.md under Decisions with the alternatives and the reason.
features.evidence: 2026-11-26, branch chore/3-phase-1-decisions (issue #3): the three decisions are rows in progress.md under Decisions made, with alternatives and reasons. Carbon: Apache-2.0, Storybook https://react.carbondesignsystem.com (index v5, 668 entries, checked 2026-11-26). LLM help deferred to Phase 5 (feat-013). Fonts: pinned download (feat-014).

features.name: DSIR 0.2 schema and validator
features.description: packages/dsir: a JSON Schema for DSIR 0.2 (adds behaviour as a WAI-ARIA pattern id and per-rule provenance to the spike's 0.1; closed style keys), a validator CLI with cross-reference checks, and the 0.1 -> 0.2 migration. Anatomy moved to feat-006 (issue #4).
features.done_when: The validator accepts the spike's shadcn DSIR converted to 0.2 and rejects at least three broken fixtures (unknown rule key, missing provenance, unknown behaviour id), each with a message naming the path; ./init.sh runs these tests.
features.evidence: 2026-11-26, branch feat/4-dsir-schema: ./init.sh ran packages/dsir: 10/10 tests pass. node bin/validate.mjs fixtures/shadcn/shadcn.dsir.json -> 'valid DSIR 0.2.0', exit 0. Rejected with the JSON path: unknown set key (/components/0/rules/7/set), missing provenance, unknown behaviour, dsirVersion 0.1.0, unknown variant value, misspelt condition, unknown colour token. CLI exits 1 on a broken file.

features.name: Move the spike code with its history
features.description: Bring Scrib's packages/scrib_ds over with git filter-repo and split it into the planned packages (emitter-flutter, primitives-flutter, oracle, enricher-shadcn, adapter-scrib).
features.done_when: git log shows the spike's commits; the moved emitter, ingest and generated-package tests pass in the new layout; the oracle reproduces 426/426 cells and 36/36 tokens; ./init.sh runs all of it.
features.evidence: 2026-11-26, branch chore/5-move-spike: git log --follow packages/oracle/compare.mjs reaches the spike's commits (8 commits via git filter-repo). Generated package byte-identical to the spike's (git status clean under it after re-emitting from the 0.2 DSIR). Oracle: 426/426 cells, 36/36 tokens, worst token dE 0.7015. ./init.sh green: dsir 10/10, emitter 5/5 (incl. emit --check), enricher 5/5 (incl. ingest --check), example package analyze clean + 9/9 tests. Deviations: primitives stay as emitter templates (no packages/primitives-flutter until generated code depends on them); the example lives in examples/shadcn-neutral, not under packages/.

features.name: Render-based extractor
features.description: packages/extractor: serve a static Storybook build, read each story's variant axes, themes and states from Storybook itself, set each cell through the preview channel, and record per element computed styles, geometry, the author rules that matched (declarations as written, so var() survives) with every referenced variable's value, and ARIA semantics.
features.done_when: Pointed at examples/shadcn-neutral/storybook's static build, it writes a measurement file per cell for Button, Badge and Card covering the same variants and states as the spike; two runs give identical files.
features.evidence: 2026-11-26, issue #15, branch feat/15-extractor: full run over examples/shadcn-neutral/storybook: 822 cells from 7 stories in 79 s; a second full run is byte-identical (diff -r). Every spike cell is covered (0 missing of 384 button, 36 badge, 6 card). Default button: '.bg-primary' -> 'background-color: var(--primary)', --primary recorded as oklch(20.5% 0 0). ./init.sh: extractor 4/4 (determinism on a subset, var() recovery, missing root fails naming the story, non-empty output refused).

features.name: Measurements to DSIR
features.description: Infer the DSIR from measurements: diff renders per axis into conditional rules, recover tokens from matched var() rules, and add anatomy (a component's parts and layout, read from the DOM) to the DSIR schema as 0.3.
features.done_when: The DSIR inferred for shadcn Button, Badge and Card validates against 0.2, and the share of colour, radius and spacing values recovered as named tokens is reported against the spike's source-derived DSIR. The schema gains anatomy, and the validator and migration cover it.
features.evidence: 2026-11-26, issue #17, branch feat/17-infer: full extraction (822 cells) -> 9 components, valid DSIR 0.3, 22,360 of 22,360 measured values explained by the mined rules; two runs byte-identical. Versus the source-derived DSIR: every colour token the source uses recovered for every component; variants and defaults match everywhere; rules about half the source's (Button 36 vs 68). Token share of observations: colour 82.5%, radius 94.2%, spacing 69.3%. Card anatomy: card-header, card-content, card-footer. ./init.sh: dsir 11/11, extractor 4/4, infer 4/4.

features.name: Phase 1 gate on shadcn/ui
features.description: Emit Flutter from the render-extracted shadcn DSIR and run the oracle at the spike's gates.
features.done_when: The oracle passes every Button, Badge and Card cell at height, padding and radius within 1 px and background within dE2000 2, light and dark.
features.evidence: 2026-11-26, issues #21 and #23, PRs #22 and the follow-up: the example package is now emitted from the DSIR inferred from the Storybook (examples/shadcn-neutral/inferred/shadcn.dsir.json; 834 cells, 8 stories). flutter analyze clean; goldens regenerated on Linux CI (update-goldens run on the branch). Oracle with those goldens: 426/426 cells (every Button, Badge and Card cell, light and dark, height/padding/radius within 1 px, background dE2000 under 2) and 36/36 tokens; the token check still reads shadcn's source theme. The emitter needed: no globals, hasSlot by data-slot, numeric radii, one-mode colour tokens; the Storybook needed a Badge WithIcon story. The update-goldens workflow had never succeeded (pathspec glob); fixed.

features.name: Phase 1 gate on Carbon
features.description: Run extract, emit and verify on IBM's Carbon design system (Apache-2.0; Storybook at https://react.carbondesignsystem.com), styled with SCSS and CSS-variable tokens rather than Tailwind.
features.done_when: Carbon's Button, Tag and Tile pass the same oracle gates against a pinned Carbon version, with every failure that remains listed in unsupported with a reason.
features.evidence: 2026-11-26, issues #25 to #29 (stacked PRs): Carbon's Button, Tag and Tile from a pinned @carbon/react 1.121.0 Storybook (examples/carbon/storybook; extractor --root; IBM Plex Sans 1.1.0 pinned, outside requests blocked; 784 cells, four themes, byte-identical across runs and with the CDN reachable or not). packages/infer: valid DSIR, 3 components, 100% of 14,416 values explained, modes white/g10/g90/g100, var() fallbacks read as tokens. packages/emitter-flutter: examples/carbon/packages/carbon_ui, flutter analyze clean. Oracle (compare-extraction.mjs against the extraction, on Linux goldens from the update-goldens workflow): 780/780 cells pass at the gates (height 0 px, padding 0 px, background dE2000 0.32, radius 0.35 px at worst; radius measurable in 157 of 268 rest cells); a damaged cell fails alone (779/780). The shadcn oracle still passes 426/426 and 36/36. Failures that remain, each with its reason, are in examples/carbon/README.md under unsupported: tile width (no fill value in the DSIR), 111 radii not measurable, ClickableTile at rest matched at hovered and focused only, text colour and SSIM not compared.

features.name: Phase 1 verdict
features.description: Write whether render-based extraction works, with the evidence, and re-plan Phase 2 on that basis.
features.done_when: docs/phase-1-verdict.md states go or no-go, links the scorecards of both systems, reports the intent-loss figure, and the roadmap in README.md is updated to match.
features.evidence: 2026-11-26, issue #35: docs/phase-1-verdict.md says go, links both scorecards (shadcn 426/426 cells and 36/36 tokens; Carbon 780/780 cells, on Linux goldens) and their reproduction commands, reports the intent-loss figure from packages/infer/bin/intent-loss.mjs (colour tokens 23/23, radius values 6/6, radius names 0/6, roles 7/9, class names on rules lost: 65 inferred vs 131 source rules), lists what was not proven (two systems, style-only, only var()-based styling, circular Carbon oracle, ungated text colour/shadows/width) and re-plans Phase 2 first. The README roadmap matches. ./init.sh green.

features.name: npm CLI
features.description: packages/cli published as @steach/stroma: init, extract, review, emit, verify and update as docs/usage.md describes, with the Dart emitter compiled to JavaScript. It exposes the coverage report and the overrides file.
features.done_when: npx @steach/stroma runs every command on the shadcn fixture from a clean machine with Node 20 alone (plus Flutter for verify); emit --check and verify exit non-zero on a stale file and on a failed gate.

features.name: Dart CLI with output parity
features.description: The pub.dev package stroma: the same commands, the emitter native, extract and verify run through the same TypeScript core on Node.
features.done_when: CI emits every fixture DSIR with both CLIs and the outputs are byte-identical; dart run stroma extract without Node exits non-zero naming Node 20 and the Docker image.

features.name: Docker image for CI
features.description: ghcr.io/steach-ide/stroma with Chromium, the Flutter SDK and the fonts pinned.
features.done_when: Two runs of verify on the shadcn fixture, on two different hosts, give identical goldens and scorecards; the image is built and pushed from a release tag.

features.name: LLM help at extraction
features.description: A model proposes DSIR facts deterministic extraction can't infer (token and variant names, intent), each marked provenance: llm and reviewed by a person. Never used when emitting.
features.done_when: To be planned once Phase 1 shows where deterministic extraction falls short. It must show that proposals reduce review work without lowering oracle pass rates.

features.name: Pinned fonts for goldens
features.description: A script downloads the fonts the goldens use from fixed URLs and checks each file's SHA-256; the emitter, the reference renderer and CI all use those files.
features.done_when: On a clean CI runner, ./init.sh runs the example package's golden tests instead of skipping them, and a font file with a wrong hash fails the download with its name.
features.evidence: 2026-11-26, PR #12: CI on a clean runner downloaded Inter 4.1, verified the zip and three fonts against tool/fonts.sha256, and ran the example's golden tests (all 6 sheets compared, passing). A byte appended to the cached Inter-Medium.ttf makes tool/fetch-fonts.sh exit 1 naming it. Oracle with the pinned fonts: 426/426 cells, 36/36 tokens. Goldens are Linux renders taken from CI (macOS differs by 1-2% of pixels, text anti-aliasing only), compared on Linux only.

features.name: A pinned shadcn Storybook
features.description: examples/shadcn-neutral/storybook: Storybook 10 of the same shadcn/ui Button, Badge and Card the enricher reads, synced byte for byte from its pinned sources, with controls generated from the registry's cva variants and a light/dark theme global.
features.done_when: pnpm run build-storybook writes an index of the Button, Badge and Card stories; the sync check fails when a component differs from the pinned source; a test fails if the story controls differ from the registry's cva config; a smoke test renders the default button in both themes with Inter loaded; ./init.sh and CI are green.
features.evidence: 2026-11-26, issue #13, branch feat/13-shadcn-storybook: ./init.sh green with the Storybook as a package: sync check up to date; build writes index v5 with 7 stories; 5/5 tests (index; argTypes read through Storybook's own storyStore.loadStory equal the registry cva config; default button renders in light and dark with Inter 500 loaded; editing badge.tsx makes the sync check exit 1 naming it). Oracle unchanged after sharing globals.css: 426/426, 36/36.

features.name: Coverage report
features.description: Extraction reports what the stories do not exercise: variant axes and options never rendered, states never reached, slots and parts never seen (the Badge icon, Carbon's clickable tile), per component.
features.done_when: stroma-extract writes a coverage section to index.json; on the shadcn Storybook before its Badge WithIcon story it lists the Badge icon slot as unobserved, and after it lists none; a component with an axis option no story renders names that option.

features.name: Pixel oracle for every system
features.description: The extractor saves a Chrome crop of the component root for every cell, and the oracle compares each with the Flutter golden (SSIM, text colour) as well as the numbers, for shadcn and Carbon alike.
features.done_when: Both systems report SSIM and text colour per cell from the extraction's own crops, with no Chrome reference sheet; the gate on text colour is stated and met or its failures listed in unsupported; two extractions give identical crops.

features.name: DSIR overrides for names
features.description: A hand-written overrides file renames components, tokens and radius steps (Btn to Button, radius-minus2 to radius-md) and sets roles and slot kinds, applied on top of the inferred DSIR and kept when it is re-inferred.
features.done_when: Re-inferring Carbon with an overrides file gives a DSIR whose components and radius tokens carry the override names and whose rules are unchanged; an override naming something that does not exist fails naming it; emit gives the same widgets under the new names and the oracle still passes.

features.name: CSS-in-JS probe
features.description: Extract one CSS-in-JS design system (Chakra UI v3 or Fluent UI v9) from a pinned Storybook with the existing extractor, to learn whether token recovery works without var() references.
features.done_when: docs/css-in-js-probe.md states, with evidence, whether the extractor and inference produce a DSIR for that system's Button, how many colour, radius and spacing values come out as named tokens, and which step failed if one did; the roadmap says whether CSS-in-JS systems are in scope.

features.name: Layout values in the DSIR
features.description: The DSIR can say a box fills its container's width (and the other layout values the Carbon tile showed), inference reads them from the render, the emitter lays them out.
features.done_when: Carbon's Tile reports a width within 1 px of Chrome's in the oracle, and width becomes a gated check for it; the shadcn oracle still passes 426/426.
